method: official web sources only, read by an automated assistant; not a human site visit

entries.name: Bess Maxwell Elementary School
entries.summary: Public elementary school in the Del Norte County Unified School District, listed by the California Department of Education as an active public elementary school. The school site is also one of the district's California State Preschool Program locations and takes part in the Community Schools Partnership Program.
entries.access_notes: School site only links to the district's website accessibility statement; no statement about physical access.
entries.hours_note: Daily schedule is linked from the site but was not read; district office hours Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-4:30 PM.
entries.notes: Grade span not stated outright; the site lists TK-2 and 3-5 assemblies, implying TK-5. CDE detail page (which would give coordinates) was blocked by a bot manager.

entries.name: Joe Hamilton Elementary School
entries.summary: Public elementary school in Del Norte County Unified, listed by CDE as an active public elementary school. The campus also hosts a California State Preschool Program classroom run by the district's Early Childhood Education department.
entries.notes: Grade span not stated on the official pages read; max_age assumes a TK-5 elementary and should be confirmed.

entries.name: Mary Peacock Elementary School
entries.summary: Public elementary school in Del Norte County Unified, listed by CDE as an active public elementary school. Its site mentions preschool, TK and kindergarten enrollment, and the campus hosts a state preschool classroom and the Child Care Council's after-school center.
entries.notes: Grade span not stated on the official pages read; max_age assumes an elementary school and should be confirmed.

entries.name: Pine Grove Elementary School
entries.address: 900 Pine Grove Road, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: Public school in Del Norte County Unified whose calendar refers to K-8 events as well as preschool, TK and kindergarten enrollment. The campus also hosts a California State Preschool Program classroom and takes part in the Community Schools Partnership Program.
entries.notes: Grade span inferred from K-8 calendar references on the official site.

entries.name: Redwood Elementary School
entries.address: 6900 Lake Earl Drive, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: Public elementary school in Del Norte County Unified on Lake Earl Drive north of town, listed by CDE as an active public elementary school. The official site gives the address and phone but does not state the grade span.
entries.notes: Official address uses Crescent City; the Lake Earl Drive site is in the Fort Dick area but no official page names Fort Dick, so community is recorded as crescent_city. Grade span not stated.

entries.name: Crescent Elk Middle School
entries.summary: The district's public middle school, listed by CDE as an active intermediate/middle school. Its site refers to 6th grade and 7/8 events and it takes part in the Community Schools Partnership Program.
entries.notes: Grades 6-8 inferred from site references and CDE school type.

entries.name: Del Norte High School
entries.address: 1301 El Dorado Street, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: The county's comprehensive public high school, listed by CDE as an active public high school, adjacent to the College of the Redwoods Del Norte campus. It participates in the Community Schools Partnership Program and publishes a bell schedule on its site.
entries.notes: Grades 9-12 inferred from CDE school type (High Schools, Public).

entries.name: Sunset High School
entries.address: 2500 Elk Valley Cross Road, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: Listed by CDE as a continuation high school in Del Norte County Unified. The campus offers a Career and Technical Education program and a community school program, and it also houses the district's Early Head Start infant/toddler center.
entries.notes: Grade span not stated on the school site; CDE type is Continuation High School.

entries.name: Castle Rock Charter School
entries.summary: A K-12 public charter school authorised by the Del Norte County Office of Education (CDE charter number 0358, locally funded). The CDE record and the county office both list the Glenn Street address; the school site has enrollment links and an academic calendar.
entries.notes: Grade span K-12 from the CDE directory record. CDE map link contains only the address, no coordinates.

entries.name: Del Norte Community School
entries.address: 400 W Harding Ave, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: A county community school operated by the Del Norte County Office of Education, listed by CDE as an active County Community school. Its site describes Title I services, counsellors, and life-skills, college and career programmes.
entries.notes: Grade span not stated on official pages; ages are an estimate for a county community school and should be confirmed.

entries.name: Uncharted Shores Academy
entries.summary: A tuition-free public charter school serving TK-9, listed by CDE as an active charter in Del Norte County Unified. It offers an in-class 'Onshore' option with credentialed teachers and a homeschool-based 'Offshore' option.
entries.cost_note: Described on the official site as tuition-free.

entries.name: DNUSD Early Childhood Education - California State Preschool Program
entries.summary: The school district runs state-funded preschool classrooms at Bess Maxwell, Joe Hamilton, Mary Peacock and Pine Grove (California State Preschool Program) and a district preschool at Smith River Elementary. Enrollment is income-based using state income tables, children must turn 3 before 1 December to qualify, and families above the income limits are still encouraged to apply.
entries.cost_note: State-funded, income-based eligibility; no fee schedule stated.
entries.hours_note: Preschool office Mon-Fri 8 AM-4 PM; classroom hours not stated.
entries.notes: Address is the ECE program office where applications are picked up; classroom sites are the five school addresses listed above. Children need not be potty trained to enrol.

entries.name: Sunset Early Head Start Center (DNUSD)
entries.address: 2500 Elk Valley Cross Rd, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: The district's Early Head Start infant/toddler centre, located on the Sunset High School campus and administered by the Early Childhood Education office at 1200 Marshall Street. It serves children from birth to age 3, with eligibility following federal poverty guidelines.
entries.cost_note: Eligibility is income-based (federal poverty guidelines); fees not stated.

entries.name: Northcoast Children's Services Infant Toddler Center / Early Head Start
entries.summary: The only Del Norte County site listed by Northcoast Children's Services, an Arcata-based nonprofit that runs Head Start, Early Head Start and state child care programmes in Humboldt and Del Norte counties. The Crescent City centre is listed as Early Head Start plus State Child Care and Development Program (license 085-403-406), serving infants and toddlers.
entries.notes: Main office: 1266 9th Street, Arcata, 707-822-7206.

entries.name: Del Norte Child Care Council
entries.summary: The county's child care resource and referral agency, a nonprofit that helps families find licensed child care, administers child care subsidies, and runs a toy lending library, car-seat lending, first aid/CPR classes, a food programme for home providers, and an after-school centre. It also trains new family child care providers.
entries.cost_note: Subsidy programmes available; fees for other services not stated.
entries.notes: Age range is an estimate of the children served by its referral and after-school services.

entries.name: Mary Peacock After School Center (Del Norte Child Care Council)
entries.summary: A licensed after-school enrichment programme run by the Child Care Council on the grounds of Mary Peacock Elementary; children do not have to attend that school to enrol. It serves TK through 5th grade, Monday to Friday from 1:00 to 5:30 pm, with enrolment through an online waitlist application.
entries.notes: Address on the page is the Council office; the programme itself operates at Mary Peacock Elementary, 1720 Arlington Drive.

entries.name: The Wonder Bus (Del Norte Child Care Council)
entries.summary: A mobile early-literacy programme that travels around Del Norte County offering story time, music and movement, crafts and play for children aged 0-6 and their caregivers. Each child chooses a free book at every visit and families can borrow books; a monthly stop calendar is emailed to registered families.
entries.cost_note: Free book per child per visit; no attendance fee mentioned.
entries.hours_note: Monthly calendar of stops sent to registered families.
entries.notes: Address is the Council office; the bus visits sites across the county.

entries.name: Family Resource Center of the Redwoods
entries.summary: A nonprofit family resource centre offering weekly children's activities (arts and crafts, baby signs, sensory play, toddler time), parenting classes (Incredible Years, Love and Logic), a postpartum group, a teen cooking class for ages 11-17, a two-week Pre-K University for incoming kindergartners, developmental screening, diaper distribution and the Pacific Pantry food pantry. Community events such as the baby shower and backpack giveaway are described as free.
entries.cost_note: Community events described as free; costs for other programmes not stated.
entries.hours_note: Diaper distribution Thu-Fri 9-5, Sat 10-2; Pacific Pantry Thu 2-5, Fri 2-4, 1st/3rd Sat 11-1.

entries.name: FRC Little Neighbors Playgroup at Gasquet Mountain School
entries.summary: A weekly playgroup run by the Family Resource Center of the Redwoods at Mountain School in Gasquet, listed on the FRC programmes page for Wednesdays 10:30 am to 12:30 pm. Ages and cost are not stated on the page.
entries.notes: Address is Mountain School's official mailing address; the school describes itself as located in Gasquet. Age range is an estimate for a playgroup.

entries.name: Del Norte County Library (Main Library)
entries.summary: The main public library of the Del Norte County Library District, an independent special district funded partly by a share of county property tax. The State Library's locations file records the Price Mall address, phone and coordinates; the district's own site indicates internet, computer and copy services.
entries.notes: The district website returned HTTP 503 on every direct fetch attempt; search-engine excerpts of the official site report hours of Mon-Sat 10 AM-6 PM, but these were not read directly and should be confirmed.

entries.name: Del Norte County Library - Smith River Branch
entries.summary: Branch library of the Del Norte County Library District in Smith River, recorded in the California State Library's local library locations file with its address, phone and coordinates. No hours or programme details were available from a reachable official page.
entries.notes: Source file is dated 2022; confirm the branch is still operating.

entries.name: Elk Valley Rancheria Library
entries.address: 2332 Howland Hill Rd, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: A small tribal library at the Elk Valley Rancheria offices that the tribe says is open to the general public. Its collection of 600-plus titles, periodicals and videos focuses on Native American culture and includes a small artefact display.
entries.notes: No children's programmes mentioned.

entries.name: College of the Redwoods - Del Norte Campus
entries.address: 883 W. Washington Blvd., Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: The Crescent City campus of the College of the Redwoods community college district, located next to Del Norte High School. The campus page lists a Student Commons help desk, TRiO and EOPS support programmes, a link for high school students, and campus and safety maps.
entries.cost_note: Community college tuition applies; not stated on the campus page.
entries.access_notes: Page links to Student Accessibility Support Services and a nondiscrimination policy covering disability, but no physical access statement.
entries.hours_note: Contact hours Mon-Thu 8 AM-5 PM; Student Commons Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM.
entries.notes: Minimum age is a rough estimate based on the high school student link; some college pages list 884 W. Washington Blvd.

entries.name: Fred Endert Municipal Pool - STARFISH Swim Lessons
entries.summary: The City of Crescent City's indoor pool runs year-round group and individual swim lessons from StarBabies/StarTots (6 months to 3.5 years, parent in water) through Pre-Swim School (3.5-6.5) and STARFISH Swim and Stroke School (6.5 and up). Group lessons are sponsored by the Del Norte Healthcare District and offered free, while individual lessons and drop-in tots classes carry fees; registration is online through the city's recreation catalogue.
entries.cost_note: Group lessons listed at $35-$48 per session but offered free through Healthcare District sponsorship; individual lessons $20-$45 per lesson; drop-in tots $6.50; general youth admission $4 (fees sheet dated Dec 2021-Feb 2022).
entries.access_notes: Fees sheet carries a city non-discrimination statement regarding handicap status but no physical access details.
entries.hours_note: Session dates listed without a year; confirm current schedule with the pool.
entries.notes: Pool address from the city's fees PDF. The pool's standalone site crescentcitypool.com returned 403.

entries.name: Del Norte County Recreation Department
entries.summary: The county's recreation department runs Tiny Tots, youth sports, teen sports, a summer kids camp, a drop-in programme and special events, with league schedules and brackets posted online. Registration is online or in person (cash or cheque in office).
entries.notes: Page also lists 981 H Street, Suite 250 in its office-hours section; which is current is unclear. Google Maps links on the page contain addresses only, no coordinates. Age range is an estimate across Tiny Tots to teen sports.

entries.name: Del Norte County 4-H Program (UC Cooperative Extension)
entries.summary: The county 4-H youth development programme administered by UC Cooperative Extension from its Crescent City office. Youth members and adult volunteers enrol online through ZSuite, clubs and projects are listed on the site, and a programme leadership team meets monthly.
entries.hours_note: Del Norte office open 8 AM-12 PM Mon-Fri (per programme page).
entries.notes: Age range reflects California 4-H's standard membership ages, not stated on the county page.

entries.name: Two Trees Student Support Center / Expanded Learning (DNCOE)
entries.address: 301 W. Washington Blvd., Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: A Del Norte County Office of Education support centre that houses the Expanded Learning Opportunities Program, offering after-school and school-break activities for students, and a Teen Center for which programme details are still to be posted.
entries.notes: Address shown is the county office address given on the page; Teen Center information was marked as pending.

entries.name: E3 Summer Youth Program (DNCOE / SMART Workforce Center)
entries.summary: A paid summer work-experience programme for high school sophomores, juniors and seniors run through the county office of education and the SMART Workforce Center. Selected students are matched with local worksites and can earn up to 10 elective credits; applications open each spring.
entries.cost_note: Participants are paid; no participation fee mentioned.

entries.name: Harmony & Me Music Outreach - Music Together classes (Crescent City)
entries.address: Redwoods Wonder Forge (STEAM), 1347 Northcrest Drive, Crescent City, CA 95531
entries.summary: A Brookings, Oregon based nonprofit that brings Music Together early-childhood music classes to Crescent City at the Redwoods Wonder Forge STEAM space. Class types include Babies (birth to about 10 months), Mixed Ages (birth to 5 with a caregiver) and Rhythm Kids (roughly ages 4-8); registration is online and scholarships are offered.
entries.cost_note: Tuition not shown on the pages read; scholarship application available.
entries.notes: Mailing address 97961 Payne Road, Brookings, OR 97415; contact info@harmonyandme.org.

entries.name: Redwood National and State Parks - Crescent City Information Center (Junior Ranger)
entries.summary: The park's downtown information centre, where families can pick up the free Junior Ranger activity booklet and return it to be sworn in and receive a badge; ranger-guided Junior Ranger activities for ages 7-12 run June through August. The NPS place listing describes the centre as wheelchair accessible with Braille and low-vision access and seasonal restrooms.
entries.cost_note: Junior Ranger booklet is free; the parks are fee-free except certain state park day-use areas.
entries.access_notes: NPS place page lists Wheelchair Accessible, low-vision access and Braille; restrooms seasonal (page last updated Oct 2020).
entries.hours_note: Visitor centres generally 9-5 in summer and 9-4 in winter per the Junior Ranger page; confirm current hours.
entries.notes: Same address as park headquarters. Booklet is for 'children of all ages'; min_age is an estimate.

entries.name: Redwood National and State Parks - Hiouchi Visitor Center (Junior Ranger)
entries.address: Highway 199, 9 miles east of Crescent City, CA 95531 (Hiouchi)
entries.summary: The parks' northern visitor centre near Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park, with exhibits, a theatre, park store and staffed information desk where Junior Ranger booklets can be collected and badges awarded. The NPS place listing records it as wheelchair accessible with an accessible restroom and Braille materials.
entries.access_notes: NPS place page lists Wheelchair Accessible and Restroom - Accessible, plus Braille (page last updated Jan 2021).
entries.notes: No street address or coordinates on NPS pages; location given as described on the NPS directions page.

entries.name: Smith River Elementary School
entries.summary: Public K-8 school in Del Norte County Unified serving the Smith River community, listed by CDE as an active public elementary school. The campus also hosts the district-run preschool for Smith River and participates in the Community Schools Partnership Program.
entries.notes: K-8 inferred from calendar references; min_age 3 reflects the on-site district preschool. ECE page writes the address as 564 W First St.

entries.name: Xaa-wan'-k'wvt (Howonquet) Early Learning Program - Tolowa Dee-ni' Nation Head Start
entries.address: 12840 Mouth of Smith River Road, Smith River, CA 95567
entries.summary: The Tolowa Dee-ni' Nation's tribal Head Start and Early Learning Center in Smith River, which prepares preschoolers for school while teaching Tolowa language and culture and is open to the local community. Tribal Head Start serves ages 3-5 on a school-year schedule (Mon-Fri 8:30-3:00), and the Early Learning Center serves ages 2 years 9 months to 5 year-round (Mon-Fri 7:30-5:30).
entries.hours_note: Head Start Mon-Fri 8:30 AM-3:00 PM (school year); Early Learning Center Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-5:30 PM (year-round).
entries.notes: Mailing address 12801 Mouth of Smith River Road. News reports describe an Early Head Start expansion for ages 0-3, but the official page read only lists the two programmes above.

entries.name: Mountain Elementary School (Gasquet)
entries.summary: A small TK-8 open-enrolment magnet school in the redwoods of Gasquet, part of Del Norte County Unified and listed by CDE as an active public elementary school. The site states the TK-8 span and that it is a magnet school.
entries.notes: Official mailing address says Crescent City though the school describes itself as located in Gasquet.

entries.name: 'O Me-nok Learning Center (Klamath)
entries.summary: Del Norte County Unified's school in Klamath, listed by CDE as an active public elementary school; its calendar refers to K-8 minimum days and the site mentions preschool, TK and kindergarten enrolment. It operates a community school programme, a library and Title I services.
entries.notes: Shares the Minot Creek Road address with the Yurok Tribe Head Start site.

entries.name: Yurok Tribe Head Start / Early Head Start - Klamath Site
entries.summary: The Yurok Tribe's Klamath Head Start site serves children aged 2 years 9 months to 5, and its Early Head Start serves birth to 3, with priority to lower-income families. The programme integrates Yurok language and culture and prepares children for public school.
entries.cost_note: Lower-income families have priority; fees not stated.
entries.notes: Tribal main office: 190 Klamath Blvd., Klamath, 707-482-1350.
